create_LlamaCanonConfig_default: create a LlamaCanonConfig instance with default LLaMA model parameters for a 32-layer transformer
create_LlamaCanonConfig_canon_layers: create a LlamaCanonConfig with canon_set, canon_bias, and canon_kernel parameters for canon layer support
create_LlamaCanonConfig_qk_norm: create a LlamaCanonConfig with qk_norm enabled for query-key normalization in attention heads
create_LlamaCanonConfig_rope_dim: create a LlamaCanonConfig with rope_dim to use partial rotary position embeddings on head dimensions
create_LlamaCanonConfig_lingua_rope: create a LlamaCanonConfig with rope_version set to lingua for compatibility with the lingua codebase RoPE
